title: Section-preserving base for actual ell-power strict quotient systems
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell. For the actual coefficient quotients and adjacent maps of [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], there exists Base b, including a positive ramification factorization, equality with the corresponding uniformizer-power ideals, finite quotients, a section-and-map-preserving additive equivalence from the recorded coefficient towers to sequence-site module sheaves, and K-injective system resolutions. For each scheme T there is semilinear derived sections data s [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] with s.systems = b.calculus T. No geometric functor, open extension or composition comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Use the chosen DVR description of O_E and the irreducibility of its specified uniformizer. Mathlib eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible factors the nonzero element ell. Since its spectral absolute value is less than one, ell is not a unit; therefore the exponent is positive. Taking powers of span {ell} = span {pi}^e gives the exact ideal equalities, and finite_coefficientExtensionRing gives finiteness.

Functor.ofOpSequence reconstructs the actual adjacent quotient tower and commutes with forgetting commutativity. Hence the recorded product-site ring presheaf is equal to the underlying ring presheaf of the existing systemRing. The verticalDiagramSite_isSheaf_iff theorem identifies its levelwise module sheaf condition with the sequence-site sheaf condition. Rebundle without changing any module or map; transport only along this coefficient-presheaf equality. Both inverse equivalence comparisons are identities and the resulting functor preserves addition.

Apply semilinearDerivedSections independently to each scheme and retain its systems field as the calculus. Its Grothendieck structure supplies K-injective resolutions through the already proved source-library instance hasKInjectiveResolutions_of_isGrothendieckAbelian. Insert these calculi and the explicitly constructed presentation and arithmetic witnesses in Base. The retained data supplies the asserted equality by reflexivity.

There is no theorem of the exact strict ell-power coordinates.
